consequence.registration: NOT frozen. dirsplit_sensitivity_selection_v1 selects candidates from per-edge demand exposure in all three route files, so the frozen selection cannot be computed without them. Freezing a registration with a placeholder candidate set would defeat the point of preregistering.
consequence.gate_matrix: Gate S is neither NO nor YES. The plan treats INCONCLUSIVE as forbidding product integration; an unrunnable gate is at least as restrictive, so Fas 2, Fas 3 and Fas 4 remain closed.

observed_while_preparing_inputs.mechanism: dirsplit/predict.py writes edge_shares_q10 as (e0 -> s10, e1 -> 1 - s90) and edge_shares_q90 as (e0 -> s90, e1 -> 1 - s10), so each outer pair sums to 1 -/+ (s90 - s10) rather than 1.
observed_while_preparing_inputs.relevance_to_sensor_107: 107 is the only station whose split forms two Level-1 targets, so there the q10 arm asks the calibrator to hit targets summing to 76-93% of the measured two-way total and the q90 arm 105-124%.
